C2C is an international CTF competition that happens annually. The qualifier happens remotely between February 6-7, and those who score high enough are invited to the in-person final competition. This year the final is in Bali, Indonesia. Last year, the organizers paid for our accommodations, and VCU paid for the plane tickets. I highly recommend checking this out. Registration is still open.
